history.name: What the client sees, and what the team sees
history.description: Every feature is marked as one the client would care about or one only the team would, and a client-facing feature can additionally carry implementation notes for whoever works on it. Those three things — the client-facing entry, its technical notes, and the purely internal work — are what the generated documents are assembled from, so one record serves both readerships without either being written twice or the client's copy filling up with detail meant for the team.
history.dev_notes: audience: "user" | "dev" plus optional dev_notes; the three Markdown docs are exactly those three combinations.
